summary: The prototype implements the 8 required screens and core interactions, but introduces rogue hex codes not present in the Design System and mocks the AI pattern detector in the Advisor Dashboard instead of wiring it to a real fetch. The corrected code enforces strict color token compliance, wires the missing AI endpoint, and upgrades the depth-first screens with the specified SVG gauges and morphing Bezier paths.

issues.description: Code introduces rogue hex codes (#F5F5F5, #464EB8, #FFF3E0, etc.) and CSS variables (--nxt-panel, --nxt-error) not present in the Design System.
issues.fix: Replace all hardcoded hex values and rogue variables with exact Design System tokens (e.g., var(--nxt-surface), var(--nxt-teal)).

issues.description: Advisor Dashboard mocks the ai_pattern_detector with a timeout instead of calling the AI fallback helper.
issues.fix: Wire fetchRisk to callAIWithFallback using the specified system prompt and caseload vectors.

issues.description: Cohort Comparison screen uses plain text stats instead of the specified Gauge and BarChart components.
issues.fix: Implement SVG-based Gauge and BarChart components with framer-motion animations.

issues.description: Portfolio Adjuster uses a static horizontal line instead of the specified morphing Bezier path for the walking avatar.
issues.fix: Implement an SVG path that morphs its 'd' attribute using useTransform based on the dial position.

issues.description: Data Map screen does not allow tapping a node to see field-level mapping as specified.
issues.fix: Add a details panel that renders the fields_in and fields_out for the activeNode.
